newsitem.title: USA: IADB awards $3 mln loan to Bolivia.
newsitem.headline: IADB awards $3 mln loan to Bolivia.

text.p: The Inter-American Development Bank Sunday said it was awarding a $3 million loan to Bolivia to strengthen and improve the country's social policy design and management.

The loan would fund training for at least 300 officials of the Bolivian Ministry of Human Development and improve management and information systems for the social sector, the IADB said in a statement.
The loan is for a 40-year term, with a 10-year grace period. Annual interest would be one percent during the grace period and two percent thereafter.
IABD President Enrique Iglesias and Bolivian Finance Minister Fernando Candia said the loan contract would be signed in Barcelona, where the IADB annual meeting begins on Monday.
